summary: The terminal UI reads each attention row's presentation (Now group, card, chat agent, raiser, held step) instead of deriving it

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The terminal UI reads Attention.presentation (presentation capability, version 1). Against an older daemon that serves none, each attention row shows st's text as a plain card, under somebody is stopped on you when st marks it an alert and when there is time otherwise, saying st does not name the card. Upgrade daemons before clients.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
